messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: service="inference-api-eu" metric="p99_latency_ms" value=520 threshold=450 — PagerDuty incident #PD-12847 created: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-12847 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Paging on-call: Amar Patel (primary) — please respond: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-12847
Amar Patel: acked. I’m on it, starting triage. pinging SREs. :eyes:
Liz Chen: saw the spike on dashboards — p95 ~210ms, p99 jumped to 520ms in last 2m. No error spike. Looks like tail latency.
Simon R-SRE: checking autoscaler + queue depth. initial thought: KV cache thrash or autoscaler not adding pods fast enough. grabbing logs.
Maya Infra: checking node utilization in eu-west-1 GPU pool — GPUs at ~78% but CPU on infra nodes spiking, also lots of batching latency.
Amar Patel: quick mitigation options: 1) scale up inference pool (temp), 2) reduce max_batch_size, 3) route small percentage to eu-central fallback model-smaller. Which first?
Liz Chen: Reduce batch size and bump pool by +2 nodes. We should also enable immediate fallback to quantized variant for latency-sensitive routes.
Simon R-SRE: running scale up now: `kubectl scale --replicas=+2 deploy/inference-eu --namespace=prod` — will monitor.
incident-bot: Deploy job submitted by Simon R-SRE — job id: deploy-7891. Expected scale up in ~45s.
Amar Patel: temporarily set per-route max_batch_size=8 for low-latency routes. Pushing config to feature flags.
Liz Chen: config change applied. confirm on global config service: `routes/infer/* -> max_batch_size=8`
Maya Infra: autoscaler accepted new nodes, 2 pods scheduled, but provisioning latency is ~60s. popping some traffic to fallback region as precaution.
Diego CS: any known customer impact? CS monitoring shows a handful of timeouts from a high-volume customer in EU. I'm opening a support ticket and notifying account owner.
Amar Patel: routing 10% traffic to eu-central smaller-model fallback: `traffic-shift: inference-api-eu -> eu-central:10% (model=redwood-small-quant)` — applied.
incident-bot: Metric update: p99 now 380ms after initial mitigations (t=+3m). p95 stable ~190ms. Still above SLO threshold but trending down.
Liz Chen: good progress. keep scaling until p99 < 300ms then slowly revert fallback. Need root cause though — KV cache miss rate increased 4x during spike.
Simon R-SRE: digging into KV cache logs: lots of evictions and TTL misses when request concurrency spiked. Looks like small working set churned. Patching cache sizing to 2x for eu pool now.
Amar Patel: increase KV cache size live: `featureflag cache.europe.size=2x` applied. Monitoring effects.
incident-bot: p99 latency 260ms (t=+8m). PagerDuty note: PD-12847 acknowledged by Amar Patel.
Liz Chen: great — on-call, let's prepare rollback plan: once stable for 10m, remove traffic-shift and revert max_batch_size.
Diego CS: notified customer rep; they reported degraded interactivity but no data loss. Keeping them updated.
Simon R-SRE: cache size change reduced miss rate. I’ll capture logs and open a follow-up (postmortem) for cache sizing + autoscaler policy.
Amar Patel: handing off to next on-call (Liz) at 23:15 UTC. Summary in thread: initial p99 spike 520ms due to KV cache thrash + autoscaler lag; mitigations: scaled pool +2 pods, reduced batch size, shifted 10% traffic to fallback, increased cache size; p99 now 260ms and trending.
Liz Chen: taking handoff. will keep monitoring for 30m and kick off a postmortem doc. tagging @Simon R-SRE for follow-up on autoscaler thresholds.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident PD-12847 status=acknowledged, assignee=Amar Patel, responders=[Amar Patel, Liz Chen, Simon R-SRE].
Amar Patel: dropping a quick runbook note here: if p99 > 450ms for >5m in eu-west-1 -> 1) scale +2, 2) reduce batch_size to 8, 3) route 10% to eu-central smaller-model, 4) bump kv cache size, 5) notify CS. I'll add to runbooks.
Liz Chen: thanks, filing the postmortem and runbook PR now. :white_check_mark:
Diego CS: keeping ticket open until customer confirms latency acceptable. Will update status.
Simon R-SRE: logging the autoscaler tweak and cache metrics to the incident board. Will follow up with a recommended autoscaler policy change in the postmortem.
incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging; will reopen if PD-12847 escalates.
